verdict.rationale: DeepInfra documents a 'flex' service_tier at a 20% discount explicitly recommended for asynchronous workloads and lower-priority tasks, satisfying the 'discount vs real-time pricing' part of the story. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated batch-job API (job submission, job ID, polling/retrieval of results) analogous to true async batch inference — flex tier appears to still be a synchronous request-response call, just deprioritized and cheaper. Missing for 10: a documented batch submission endpoint/job lifecycle, evidence of large-scale offline batch processing, and independent confirmation of discount/behavior.
